## Hello!

I am an MSc Urban Spatial Science student at the Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis (CASA), University College London.

I'm a fan of cities, walkability, and sesame bagels, and I'm interested in using data to understand the relationships between people and their spatial environments.

Check out my [projects](https://lukegbenson.github.io/projects/) to see what I've been up to!
